title: Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: A classic Argentinian dish, these beef empanadas are a delicious twist on traditional empanadas. Made with gluten-free ingredients, they're perfect for those with dietary restrictions.

ingredients.name: Nutty Caramelized Onions
ingredients.notes: Caramelize 1 large onion with 1 tablespoon olive oil until golden brown

instructions: Roll out empanada dough to desired thickness.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with egg wash.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
